prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the crash, and the presenting symptoms align well with that mechanism. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. Over the course of 23 visits, care followed a typical progression of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graduated strengthening. Symptoms and function improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered as the patient regained motion and strength. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same region years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service, with no repeated charges for the same care. Patient is progressing well and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home program adherence.
